title: Configure oxlint/oxfmt for a project
description: Add project-level oxlint/oxfmt configuration (and optionally explicit targets) to an existing Nx project.

oxlint.description: Create a project-level `.oxlintrc.json` when missing (enables inferred lint targets).

addTargets.description: Add explicit executor targets to the project configuration instead of relying solely on inference.

lintTargetName.description: Lint target name when addTargets is true.

formatTargetName.description: Format target name when addTargets is true.

formatCheckTargetName.description: Format-check target name when addTargets is true.
